hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: G0001 = (F(p)-F(q))/(p-q); G0002 = dF/dz evaluated at z=p, with F(z)=s(z)
required_assumptions: s is defined and differentiable at p
p and q are independent symbolic variables
ds(p) denotes the derivative of s at p
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The two catalog expressions are the finite difference quotient and derivative of the same underlying function s. The piecewise branch G0002 is the limiting/degenerate case of G0001 as q approaches p.
